notes.title: Shitlings slowly hatching
notes.content:
Game production is at full speed now. Every day, new pitiful creatures are born and those already alive gain new useless skills. Just like in real life. If you're interested in being part of this process or just want to make fun of the struggling, hopeless devs, join our [b]Discord[/b]. I promise you will regret it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505624/cb669053c7ab778eb9c989f3e85cb6387de0ca55.png[/img]
If you want to go even further and waste some of your time on playing unfinished game-like product, you might have a chance. I will organize a [b]closed playtest around June / July[/b]. 
Any feedback, ideas and sarcastic comments are appreciated. That's what Shitlings feed on.
